content: Create an application that designs a layout having text boxes and button

mobile number, address, city and specialization should be entered by the
user in the textboxes and on clicking on the button submit the data should
be saved into the database.

view. Doc_detail (doc_id, firstname, lastname, mob, add, city,
specialization)
